name: planka
description: This folder ports the official Planka production Docker setup into this repository for the Kanban surface.

scripts.db:migrate:local: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm planka npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:prod: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm planka npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:create-admin:local: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm planka npm run db:create-admin-user
scripts.db:create-admin:prod: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm planka npm run db:create-admin-user
